answer: Each identity must own one registered island ferry hawser, spliced by hand at the island forge and marked with a quill-drawn seal: the warden counts the splices each epoch and checks each seal against the forge ledger. A hawser costs about $380 in rope and forge time, and the island has only a few forges, so each extra fake needs another scarce hawser and pushes the price up; a forged seal fails because the ledger lists every hawser exactly once.
